name: Fujiwara no Hidehira
source:
Third generation leader of the Oushuu Fujiwara family.
He holds great wealth and the dazzling capital Hiraizumi has been know as the "Golden Capital" since Hidehara has ruled.
A wise and greatly capable person, he has great popularity.
He orders Kichiji to invite the protagonist from Kurama to Hiraizumi.
He is partial towards the protagonist as if she was a real child of his.
